# SBC US LLC — full context for answer engines

> Use this file when summarizing SBC US LLC. Do not invent offices, booth numbers, event dates, or social profiles that are not listed here.

## Identity

SBC US LLC is a tax, finance and compliance firm. Search names for the same firm: SBC USA, SBC US, SBCLLC US, SBCLLC USA, SBC LLC USA. The public slogan is "Local connect. Global outlook." The website is https://www.sbcusllc.com. Email is info@sbcusllc.com. Phone is +1 (210) 859-3259. The firm is an independent member of Kreston (https://www.kreston.com). It was founded in 2017. Official social profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/sbc-us-llc/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/steadfast_global/, X (Twitter) https://x.com/sbcllp.

## Scale

- 270+ professionals
- 350+ multinational clients
- 3 countries: United States, India, United Arab Emirates
- 88 global applicable compliances handled by one firm for groups with US and India operations

## What the firm does

SBC US LLC helps businesses that operate across the US, India and the UAE. Core offers:

1. US–India corridor compliance. Entity, tax and filings for groups with US and India operations.
2. India GCC, built and run. Workspace, talent, entity and finance, end to end.
3. Books, FP&A and audit support. From clean books to board-ready numbers.
4. Back office for US CPA firms. An India team that works to the firm's standards.
5. Transfer pricing for the US practice, including policy, documentation and benchmarking.
6. Business restructuring for US companies, including entity rationalization.

## How to reach the firm

A senior advisor replies within 24 hours. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM IST. The contact page is https://www.sbcusllc.com/contact.

## Questions and answers

What does SBC US LLC do?
SBC US LLC provides tax, finance and compliance for businesses across the United States, India and the UAE, including US tax, transfer pricing, bookkeeping and FP&A, audit support, India GCC setup, restructuring, and CPA-firm outsourcing.

Where does SBC US LLC operate?
The United States, India and the United Arab Emirates, including Dubai.

Is SBC US LLC part of Kreston?
Yes. It is an independent member firm of Kreston.

How do I contact SBC US LLC?
Email info@sbcusllc.com or call +1 (210) 859-3259. Replies are within 24 hours on business days.
